#### Problem 1 b)

```{r}
lambda_A <- 2      # goals per game
lambda_B <- 1.5

#P(tie | no goals up to t)
tie_prob_b <- function(t) {
  lA <- lambda_A * (90 - t) / 90
  lB <- lambda_B * (90 - t) / 90
  # sum over k (truncate at 50, negligible error beyond)
  k  <- 0:50
  sum(exp(-(lA + lB)) * (lA * lB)^k / (factorial(k))^2)
}

t_b <- seq(0, 90, by = 0.5)
p_b <- sapply(t_b, tie_prob_b)

plot(t_b, p_b,
     type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Time t (minutes)",
     ylab = "P(tie | no goals up to t)",
     main = "Part (b): Otis's tie probability given no goals up to t",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
abline(h = c(0, 1), lty = 2, col = "gray")
```

#### Part c)

```{r}
#t in [0, 60) 
t_c1 <- seq(0, 60, by = 0.5)
p_c1 <- sapply(t_c1, tie_prob_b)

#t in [60, 90] — score is 1-0
tie_prob_c <- function(t) {
  lA <- lambda_A * (90 - t) / 90
  lB <- lambda_B * (90 - t) / 90
  lB * exp(-(lA + lB))
}

t_c2 <- seq(60, 90, by = 0.5)
p_c2 <- sapply(t_c2, tie_prob_c)

plot(NA,
     xlim = c(0, 90), ylim = c(0, 0.5),
     xlab = "Time t (minutes)",
     ylab = "P(tie)",
     main = "Part (c): Otis's hopes rise then evaporate (goal by A at t=60)")

# Region 1
lines(t_c1, p_c1, lwd = 2, col = "steelblue")

# Region 2
lines(t_c2, p_c2, lwd = 2, col = "tomato")

# Mark the discontinuity at t = 60
points(60, tie_prob_b(60),  pch = 19, col = "steelblue")   
points(60, tie_prob_c(60),  pch = 1,  col = "tomato")       

# Mark the peak at t* ≈ 64.3
t_peak <- 90 - 90/3.5
p_peak <- tie_prob_c(t_peak)
points(t_peak, p_peak, pch = 8, col = "tomato", cex = 1.2)
text(t_peak, p_peak + 0.02,
     labels = paste0("peak t≈", round(t_peak, 1)),
     col = "tomato", cex = 0.8)

# Vertical line at t = 60
abline(v = 60, lty = 2, col = "gray")

legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Score 0-0 (part b)", "Score 1-0 (part c)", "Peak"),
       col    = c("steelblue", "tomato", "tomato"),
       lty    = c(1, 1, NA),
       pch    = c(NA, NA, 8),
       lwd    = 2, bty = "n")
```

#### Problem 2 part c)

```{r}
# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lambda <- 3
T_game <- 48

# ── Simulate arrivals ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sim_poisson_arrivals <- function(lambda, T_max) {
  arrivals <- c()
  t <- 0
  repeat {
    t <- t + rexp(1, rate = lambda)
    if (t > T_max) break
    arrivals <- c(arrivals, t)
  }
  arrivals
}

set.seed(42)
times_A <- sim_poisson_arrivals(lambda, T_game)
times_B <- sim_poisson_arrivals(lambda, T_game)

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
par(mfrow = c(2,1), mar = c(2, 4, 3, 2))

# Top: Team A
plot(NA, xlim = c(0, T_game), ylim = c(0, 1),
     yaxt = "n", xaxt = "n",
     xlab = "", ylab = "",
     main = expression(paste("Part (c): Basket arrival times  (", lambda, " = 3/min, T = 48 min)")))
segments(times_A, 0, times_A, 1, col = "tomato", lwd = 1)
mtext("Team A", side = 2, line = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "tomato")

# Bottom: Team B
par(mar = c(5, 4, 1, 2))
plot(NA, xlim = c(0, T_game), ylim = c(0, 1),
     yaxt = "n",
     xlab = "Time (minutes)", ylab = "")
segments(times_B, 0, times_B, 1, col = "steelblue", lwd = 1)
mtext("Team B", side = 2, line = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "steelblue")

# Reset
par(mfrow = c(1,1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))

```

#### Part d)

```{r}
# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lambda <- 3
T_game <- 48

# ── Simulate merged process ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
times_merged <- sim_poisson_arrivals(2 * lambda, T_game)

# Assign each arrival to A or B with prob 1/2
assignments <- sample(c("A", "B"), size = length(times_merged), replace = TRUE)
times_A_d   <- times_merged[assignments == "A"]
times_B_d   <- times_merged[assignments == "B"]

cat("Part (d):\n")
cat("  Total baskets:", length(times_merged), "\n")
cat("  Team A baskets:", length(times_A_d), "\n")
cat("  Team B baskets:", length(times_B_d), "\n")

# ── Plot (first 10 min for readability, same as part c) ───────────────────────
par(mfrow = c(2,1), mar = c(2, 4, 3, 2))

# Top: Team A
plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 10), ylim = c(0, 1),
     yaxt = "n", xaxt = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "",
     main = "Part (d): Merged process, each basket assigned A or B w.p. 1/2 (first 10 min)")
segments(times_A_d[times_A_d <= 10], 0,
         times_A_d[times_A_d <= 10], 1,
         col = "tomato", lwd = 1.2)
mtext("Team A", side = 2, line = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "tomato")

# Bottom: Team B
par(mar = c(5, 4, 1, 2))
plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 10), ylim = c(0, 1),
     yaxt = "n", xlab = "Time (minutes)", ylab = "")
segments(times_B_d[times_B_d <= 10], 0,
         times_B_d[times_B_d <= 10], 1,
         col = "steelblue", lwd = 1.2)
mtext("Team B", side = 2, line = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "steelblue")

par(mfrow = c(1,1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
```

#### Part e)

```{r}
# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lambda <- 3
t      <- 48
n_sim  <- 1e5

# ── Simulate 10^5 games ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
N   <- rpois(n_sim, lambda = 2 * lambda * t)      # total baskets both teams
N_A <- rbinom(n_sim, size = N, prob = 0.5)        # A's share
N_B <- N - N_A                                     # B's share
D   <- 2 * (N_A - N_B)                            # score difference

# ── Empirical estimates ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
emp_mean <- mean(D)
emp_var  <- var(D)
emp_tie  <- mean(D == 0)

# ── Theoretical values ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theo_mean <- 0
theo_var  <- 8 * lambda * t
theo_tie  <- exp(-2 * lambda * t) * sum(
               (lambda * t)^(2 * 0:500) / (factorial(0:500))^2
             )

# ── Print comparison ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Part (e): t = 48, lambda = 3, n_sim = 1e5\n\n")
cat(sprintf("           Empirical    Theoretical\n"))
cat(sprintf("E[D(t)]:   %8.4f     %8.4f\n", emp_mean, theo_mean))
cat(sprintf("Var[D(t)]: %8.4f     %8.4f\n", emp_var,  theo_var))
cat(sprintf("P(D=0):    %8.4f     %8.4f\n", emp_tie,  theo_tie))

# ── Plot histogram of D ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
hist(D,
     breaks = 80,
     col    = "steelblue",
     border = "white",
     freq   = FALSE,
     main   = expression(paste("Part (e): Distribution of D(48) over ", 10^5, " simulated games")),
     xlab   = "D(48) = 2(N_A - N_B)  (points)",
     ylab   = "Density")
abline(v  = 0,   col = "tomato", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(v  = emp_mean, col = "black", lwd = 1.5, lty = 3)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("D = 0 (tie)", "Empirical mean"),
       col    = c("tomato", "black"),
       lty    = c(2, 3),
       lwd    = 2,
       bty    = "n")
```

#### Problem 3 part a) integral

```{r}
integrand <- function(t) {
  exp(-t/2 - t^3/5400)
}

result <- integrate(integrand,
                    lower = 0,
                    upper = Inf)
print(result)
```

#### Problem 3 Part c)

```{r}
# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lambda <- function(t) 0.5 * (1 + (t/30)^2)   # rate function
T_max  <- 120                                  # days
lambda_max <- lambda(T_max)                    # = 8.5, max occurs at t=120

cat("lambda_MAX =", lambda_max, "\n")

# ── Step 1: Sample from HPPP(lambda_max) ──────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
candidate_times <- sim_poisson_arrivals(lambda_max, T_max)
cat("Candidate arrivals (before thinning):", length(candidate_times), "\n")

# ── Step 2: Accept each time T_i with prob lambda(T_i) / lambda_max ───────────
u               <- runif(length(candidate_times))
keep            <- u < lambda(candidate_times) / lambda_max
accepted_times  <- candidate_times[keep]

cat("Accepted arrivals (after thinning):  ", length(accepted_times), "\n")
cat("Expected total reports (theory):      ", 380, "\n")

# ── Plot histogram ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
hist(accepted_times,
     breaks = 30,
     col    = "steelblue",
     border = "white",
     main   = "Part (c): Flu report times via acceptance-rejection NHPP",
     xlab   = "Time t (days from Sept. 1)",
     ylab   = "Number of reports per bin",
     freq   = TRUE)

# Overlay the theoretical rate curve scaled to counts
t_seq <- seq(0, 120, by = 0.5)
bin_width <- 120 / 30    # = 4 days per bin
lines(t_seq, lambda(t_seq) * bin_width,
      col = "tomato", lwd = 2)

legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Simulated reports", expression(lambda(t) %.% bin_width)),
       col    = c("steelblue", "tomato"),
       lty    = c(NA, 1),
       pch    = c(15, NA),
       lwd    = c(NA, 2),
       bty    = "n")

# ── Print comparison ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat(sprintf("\nComparison:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Simulated total reports: %d\n",   length(accepted_times)))
cat(sprintf("  Theoretical E[N(120)]:   %d\n",   380))
cat(sprintf("  Difference:              %d\n",   length(accepted_times) - 380))
```
